findings.detail: new start_service + uvicorn.Server can compose with existing CPU retrieval/Java start_services; old candidate launcher selects old grammar worker and must not be used unchanged

Popen.terminate on Windows can bypass Python finally; do not apply generic stop_process to the RAG worker. Prefer in-process uvicorn.Server.should_exit plus awaited thread exit, then owned context exit; or separately verify CTRL_BREAK process-group path. Full worker and native/drain exit within5s still unverified.

generic e2e runner clears actual retrieval and substitutes generation fixture for selected specs; cannot count it as live native integration. Live browser/API driver must target the explicitly owned real service and registered requests only.

startup120 requires authenticated HTTP readiness, not just native_adapter_startup_seconds. prepare hashes GGUF in download verification and receipt construction; both generator.load calls hash GGUF again. Existing cached receipt cannot replace production hashing. No fullweight rehash performed during preflight.

Worker availability does not change default bm25; actual acceptance must explicitly select hybrid_rerank and base with answer limit5. CPU retrieval --device cpu is mandatory; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty is optional extra isolation only in retrieval child, never in generation parent environment.

70 expected artifact files exist and match size;62 files up to32MiB freshly hashed and match;8 large artifacts use cached expected hashes with current sizes only. Cached records are adequate for this preflight, never a substitute for existing production identity checks.
